purpose: Independent scientific-model implementation validation; no selection or primary outcome inference.

jointFamily.method: Two-sided Clopper-Pearson intervals; Bonferroni, family alpha=.01 under independent-run sampling model

audit.interpretation: Pointwise 95% misses are expected when many intervals are inspected and are reported honestly. The simultaneous 99% joint-law audit checks (NH,NV,terminal reason), not the full spatial-mask law or every kinetic distribution. Student-t mean intervals are CLT-based; endpoint allowance1e-12 addresses floating arithmetic only.
